sentences.en: The adaptation was so sugar-coated it made me sick.
sentences.zh: 这部电影改编得太过甜腻，让我感到反胃。

sentences.en: This film is an adaptation of a novel.
sentences.zh: 这部影片是根据一部小说改编的。

sentences.en: The adaptation by a popular writer has breathed new life into this classic.
sentences.zh: 这位流行作家的改编让这部经典作品重获新生。

senses.zh: 改编本，改写本；适应，改变；适应（性），适应力；适应性变化
